name: The Belle II Physics Book
notes: The PTEP article number commonly cited as 123C01 was not confirmed by any source consulted; only the journal, year and DOI (10.1093/ptep/ptz106) were read.

summary.plain: A book-length survey of the physics questions Belle II is designed to answer, written by the collaboration together with theorists.
summary.technical: E. Kou, P. Urquijo et al., 'The Belle II Physics Book', Prog. Theor. Exp. Phys. (2019), arXiv:1808.10567: the physics programme across nine working groups for data sets up to 50 ab⁻¹.
